proposed_comments.title: Keep the unit-test source out of the production DLL

confidence.rationale: The production CursorWrap project currently compiles MonitorTopologyTests.cpp even though that file includes Visual Studio CppUnitTest headers and test-only classes.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the unit-test source out of the production DLL

**Severity:** `high`

`MonitorTopologyTests.cpp` is included in the production CursorWrap DLL project. That source depends on `CppUnitTest.h`, so the release build can fail to resolve test-only headers; even if it compiled, the test class should not ship in the module binary. Keep the source only in the dedicated CursorWrap unit-test project.

```suggestion
    <ClCompile Include="trace.cpp" />
```

proposed_comments.title: Block vertical movement at suppressed top corners

confidence.rationale: At a top-left or top-right corner, removing only the Top candidate leaves Left or Right available, so vertical movement can still wrap sideways instead of being blocked.

proposed_comments.title: Cover suppressed top-corner direction handling

confidence.rationale: The added topology tests cover straight edges and lower monitors, but they do not exercise the top-corner fallback that currently allows upward movement to wrap sideways.

proposed_comments.title: Synchronize the live RDP suppression setting

confidence.rationale: set_config writes this field on the runner thread while MouseHookProc reads it on the hook thread, matching the existing reason m_hookActive is atomic.

proposed_comments.body:
### Synchronize the live RDP suppression setting

**Severity:** `medium`

`set_config` updates this option on the runner thread while `MouseHookProc` reads it on the separate low-level mouse hook thread. A plain `bool` makes live settings changes a C++ data race. Store the setting atomically, matching the existing hook-thread state pattern, and read it with a relaxed load in the hook path.

```suggestion
    std::atomic_bool m_suppressTopEdgeWrapInRemoteSession = false; // Default to false; keeps the RDP connection bar reachable
```

> Also update the hook read to `m_suppressTopEdgeWrapInRemoteSession.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)` where `suppressTopEdgeWrap` is computed.

proposed_comments.title: Read the RDP suppression setting atomically in the hook

confidence.rationale: This is the paired hook-thread read for the setting made atomic above; without it the code will not compile after changing the field type.

proposed_comments.body:
### Read the RDP suppression setting atomically in the hook

**Severity:** `medium`

After the setting is made atomic, the hook path should read the current value explicitly. A relaxed load is enough here because the flag is a standalone setting and the hook only needs a current boolean value without ordering other data.

```suggestion
                bool suppressTopEdgeWrap = g_cursorWrapInstance->m_suppressTopEdgeWrapInRemoteSession.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) &&
```

> Apply this together with the field-type suggestion above.
